description: This file contains platform-specific functions for checking, upgrading, and copying configuration for various embedded device boards within a Linux-based system, likely part of an OpenWrt or similar firmware build system.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the image for the current device board, delegating to specific functions based on board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process tailored to specific device boards.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration files based on board name.
